welcome.preheader: Choose your account type: stylist or client.
welcome.heading: Welcome to Nailfolio
welcome.body:
Your account has been created. Open the app and choose an account type: stylist or client.

A stylist account provides a gallery of your work with filters for color, length and design traits. A client can collect photos in Inspiration Sessions and share them with a connected stylist.
welcome.ps: Something not working, or a question? Reply to this email.

onboarding-incomplete.preheader: Choose your account type to finish setup.
onboarding-incomplete.heading: Finish account setup
onboarding-incomplete.body:
Your Nailfolio account setup is incomplete. Choose "stylist" if you create nail designs, or "client" if you collect inspiration for appointments.

If you need help with setup, reply to this email.

trial-nudge-upload.preheader: Upload a nail design photo and select its color, length and traits.
trial-nudge-upload.heading: Add your first gallery photo
trial-nudge-upload.body:
Upload a nail design photo from your phone. You can crop it and select its color, length and traits. These details let clients filter gallery photos.

Connected clients see your full gallery. Photos pinned to your public profile can also be viewed without an account.

trial-empty-portfolio.preheader: Your gallery does not contain any nail design photos yet.
trial-empty-portfolio.heading: Add nail designs to your gallery
trial-empty-portfolio.body:
Your gallery does not contain any photos yet. Your {{planName}} trial continues for {{trialDaysLeft#more day|more days}}.

Add nail design photos and select their color, length and traits. You can pin selected photos to your public profile.

trial-celebration.preheader: Your permanent QR code lets a client send a connection request.
trial-celebration.heading: Connect with clients
trial-celebration.body:
Your gallery now contains nail design photos. To give a client access to the full gallery, show them your permanent QR code. After scanning it and signing in, the client sends a connection request. They gain access to your full gallery after you accept the request.

Your permanent QR code is available in the app. You can download and print it.

trial-progress.preheader: Pinned photos appear on your public profile.
trial-progress.heading: Your first week of the {{planName}} trial
trial-progress.body:
You can pin selected photos to your public profile. The profile is accessible without an account and shows pinned photos and the details you add to it.

You can share your profile link with clients or add it to your Instagram bio.

trial-social-proof.preheader: Color, length and design traits help clients filter photos.
trial-social-proof.heading: Adding and filtering nail designs
trial-social-proof.body:
In your gallery, you can label photos with color, length and design traits. Filters let clients browse work matching their selected criteria.

Your {{planName}} trial continues for {{trialDaysLeft#more day|more days}}. During this time, you can add photos and try the gallery filters.

trial-milestone.preheader: Complete your public profile and share your QR code with clients.
trial-milestone.heading: Halfway through your trial
trial-milestone.body:
Two weeks of your trial have passed. Your {{planName}} trial continues for {{trialDaysLeft#more day|more days}}.

Your public profile shows your bio, phone number and pinned photos. Your permanent QR code lets a client send a connection request after signing in. Once you accept it, the client can see your full gallery.

trial-fomo.preheader: During the trial you can add photos and set up your public profile.
trial-fomo.heading: Add photos during your trial
trial-fomo.body:
Half of your trial has passed. Your {{planName}} trial continues for {{trialDaysLeft#more day|more days}}.

Add nail design photos and pin selected work to your public profile. You can open the profile to check how it looks to someone without an account. If you need help, reply to this email.

trial-warning.preheader: The {{planName}} plan becomes paid after the trial. You can change or cancel your subscription beforehand.
trial-warning.heading: One week until the trial ends
trial-warning.body:
Your trial ends on {{trialEndDate}}. From that date, {{planName}} becomes paid and the first payment will be charged to the card saved when you started the trial.

To change or cancel your subscription before the first payment, open your account settings before that date.
trial-warning.bodyInactive:
Your trial ends on {{trialEndDate}}. From that date, {{planName}} becomes paid and the first payment will be charged to the card saved when you started the trial.

To change or cancel your subscription before the first payment, open your account settings before that date.
trial-warning.ps: A question about the payment or the plan? Reply to this email.

trial-last-day.preheader: Your trial ends tomorrow and the first payment will be charged to your saved card.
trial-last-day.heading: Today is the last day of the trial
trial-last-day.body: From tomorrow, {{planName}} becomes paid. You can continue adding unlimited photos and clients, and pin more photos to your public profile. Connected clients can access your full gallery.
trial-last-day.bodyInactive:
From tomorrow, {{planName}} becomes paid. To avoid the first payment, change or cancel your subscription in account settings today.

After switching to Free, saved photos and connections remain in your account. Adding more photos and clients is subject to Free plan limits.
trial-last-day.offerApplied: Your first paid month has a 20% discount. The discount is already applied to your account.
trial-last-day.ps: To switch to Free before the first payment, change or cancel your subscription today. Saved photos and connections remain, and connected clients still see your full gallery. Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5 and connect with up to 2 clients.

trial-ended.preheader: Your trial has ended. Your account is now on the Free plan.
trial-ended.heading: Your trial has ended
trial-ended.body:
Your {{planName}} trial ended without a paid subscription starting. Your account is now on Free. Saved photos and connections remain in your account, and connected clients still see your full gallery.

Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5 and connect with up to 2 clients. Your public profile shows 3 pinned photos. You can reactivate {{planName}} in account settings.
trial-ended.bodyZero:
Your {{planName}} trial ended without a paid subscription starting. Your account is now on Free.

Free allows you to add 5 photos and connect with 2 clients. If you need help with your account or gallery, reply to this email.

trial-winback.preheader: 20% off your first month. The code can be used once and is valid for 72 hours.
trial-winback.preheaderNoOffer: Your account is on Free. Saved photos and connections remain available.
trial-winback.heading: Switching from Free to a paid plan
trial-winback.body:
Your trial has ended. Your account is on Free. Saved photos and connections remain in your account. Connected clients still see your full gallery. Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5, connect with up to 2 clients and show 3 pinned photos on your public profile.

A 20% discount is available for your first month of {{planName}}. The code below is assigned to your account and can be used once.
trial-winback.bodyNoOffer:
Your trial has ended. Your account is on Free. Saved photos and connections remain in your account. Connected clients still see your full gallery. Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5, connect with up to 2 clients and show 3 pinned photos on your public profile.

You can reactivate {{planName}} in account settings.
trial-winback.offerFinePrint: The discount applies to the first monthly plan payment and can be used once. Use the button below to apply it at checkout.
trial-winback.ps: Your Free plan remains active. Changing plans is optional.

cancel-d1.preheader: After your subscription ends, your account uses the Free plan.
cancel-d1.heading: Your subscription has ended
cancel-d1.body: Your subscription has ended. Your account is now on Free. Saved photos and connections remain in your account. If you need help or would like to provide feedback, reply to this email.

cancel-d7-winback.preheader: 20% off your first month. The code can be used once and is valid for 72 hours.
cancel-d7-winback.preheaderNoOffer: Your account is on Free. Saved photos and connections remain available.
cancel-d7-winback.heading: Switching from Free to a paid plan
cancel-d7-winback.body:
Your subscription ended a week ago. Your account is on Free. Saved photos and connections remain in your account. Connected clients still see your full gallery. Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5, connect with up to 2 clients and show 3 pinned photos on your public profile.

A 20% discount is available for your first month of {{planName}}. The code below is assigned to your account and can be used once.
cancel-d7-winback.bodyNoOffer:
Your subscription ended a week ago. Your account is on Free. Saved photos and connections remain in your account. Connected clients still see your full gallery. Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5, connect with up to 2 clients and show 3 pinned photos on your public profile.

You can reactivate {{planName}} in account settings.
cancel-d7-winback.offerFinePrint: The discount applies to the first monthly plan payment and can be used once. Use the button below to apply it at checkout.
cancel-d7-winback.ps: Your Free plan remains active. Changing plans is optional.

cancel-d30-final.preheader: Your public profile remains available on the Free plan.
cancel-d30-final.heading: Your public profile on Free
cancel-d30-final.body: This is the final reminder following your switch to Free. Your public profile remains available and shows 3 pinned photos. You can review them in your gallery and change your selection. You can reactivate a paid plan in account settings.

upgrade-confirmation.preheader: You can add unlimited photos and clients, and pin more photos to your profile.
upgrade-confirmation.heading: Your {{planName}} plan is active
upgrade-confirmation.body:
Your paid plan is active. You can add unlimited photos and clients, and pin more photos to your public profile.

Pinned photos are visible on your public profile without an account. If you need help, reply to this email.

downgrade-notification.preheader: Adding photos and clients is now subject to Free plan limits.
downgrade-notification.heading: You're on the Free plan
downgrade-notification.body: Your account is now on Free. Saved photos and connections remain. Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5, connect with up to 2 clients and show 3 pinned photos on your public profile. You can reactivate a paid plan in account settings.

payment-failed.preheader: Check your card's expiry date and whether online payments are enabled.
payment-failed.heading: Payment failed
payment-failed.body: Payment for {{planName}} failed. Check your card expiry date, limit and whether online payments are enabled. You can update your card in account settings. Payment will be retried automatically.

dunning-info.preheader: Check the card details saved in your account.
dunning-info.heading: Payment failed
dunning-info.body: Payment for {{planName}} failed. Your plan is still active. Check the card in account settings: its expiry date, limit and whether online payments are enabled. Update your card details if needed.

dunning-urgent.preheader: An unpaid subscription will end with a switch to the Free plan.
dunning-urgent.heading: Payment retry failed
dunning-urgent.body:
A payment retry for {{planName}} failed. If your subscription remains unpaid, your account will move to Free. Saved photos and connections remain in your account. Connected clients still see your full gallery. Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5, connect with up to 2 clients and show 3 pinned photos on your public profile.

Check or update your card in account settings. If you need help, reply to this email.
dunning-urgent.bodyZero: A payment retry for {{planName}} failed. If your subscription remains unpaid, your account will move to Free. Check or update your card in account settings. If you need help, reply to this email.

dunning-final.preheader: The final payment attempt failed. Without payment, your account will move to Free.
dunning-final.heading: Final payment attempt failed
dunning-final.body:
The final payment attempt for {{planName}} failed. If your subscription remains unpaid, your account will move to Free. Saved photos and connections remain in your account. Connected clients still see your full gallery. Free allows you to add photos up to a limit of 5, connect with up to 2 clients and show 3 pinned photos on your public profile.

To stay on a paid plan, check your card in account settings today. If you choose Free, no action is needed.
dunning-final.bodyZero: The final payment attempt for {{planName}} failed. If your subscription remains unpaid, your account will move to Free. To stay on a paid plan, check your card in account settings today. If you choose Free, no action is needed.

pairing-notification.preheader: The connection is established. The client can access your full gallery.
pairing-notification.heading: You have a new client
pairing-notification.body: The connection with {{clientName}} is established. The client now has access to your full gallery and appears on your connections list.

pair-request-notification.preheader: Accept in the app and they'll see your full gallery.
pair-request-notification.heading: A new connection request
pair-request-notification.body: {{clientName}} sent a connection request. Accepting it gives the client access to your full gallery. You can also decline the request.

session-shared-notification.preheader: The shared session contains selected photos and notes. It is available for 7 days.
session-shared-notification.heading: Shared Inspiration Session
session-shared-notification.body: {{clientName}} shared an Inspiration Session with selected photos and notes. You can view the session in the app for 7 days after it was shared.

messaging-notification.preheader: You can reply in the app, under Messages.
messaging-notification.heading: You have a new message
messaging-notification.body: {{senderName}} sent you a message in Nailfolio. Open Messages in the app to read it and reply.

salon-staff-invitation.preheader: You can accept or decline the invitation in the app.
salon-staff-invitation.heading: An invitation to a salon team
salon-staff-invitation.body: {{inviterName}} has invited you to a salon team in Nailfolio. After you accept, {{inviterName}} will see your name and photo on the team list. Until then, only your email address is visible. Membership on the team list does not grant access to the salon gallery or account data. You can decline the invitation.

renewal-reminder.preheader: Your subscription renewal and automatic payment are approaching.
renewal-reminder.heading: Your plan renews in a week
renewal-reminder.body: Your {{planName}} plan will renew automatically on {{renewalDate}}. Payment will be charged to the card saved in your account. To change or cancel your subscription, open your account settings before that date.

magic-link.preheader: Your login link can be used once and is valid for one hour.
magic-link.heading: Your login link
magic-link.body: Use the button to sign in to Nailfolio or finish creating your account. The link can be used once and is valid for one hour.
magic-link.copyLinkLabel: The button doesn't work? Copy this link:
magic-link.ignoreNote: If you did not request a login link, ignore this email. Do not share the link with anyone else.

account-delete-confirm.preheader: Account deletion requires confirmation. The link is valid for 24 hours.
account-delete-confirm.heading: Confirm account deletion
account-delete-confirm.body: A request to delete your Nailfolio account has been received. Confirm it using the button below within 24 hours. After confirmation, you can restore the account for 90 days by signing in again with the same email address.
account-delete-confirm.ignoreNote: If you did not request account deletion, do not confirm it. Contact support by replying to this email. Your account will not be deleted without confirmation.

account-deleted-recovery.preheader: You can restore your account for 90 days by signing in with the same email address.
account-deleted-recovery.heading: Account closed. Restoration is available for 90 days.
account-deleted-recovery.body: Your Nailfolio account has been closed as requested. You can restore it for 90 days by signing in with the same email address. After that period, the account will be permanently closed.
account-deleted-recovery.ignoreNote: If this is what you wanted, there's nothing to do. If you want the data gone right away and for good, write to support@nailfolio.app.

email-change-confirm.preheader: Confirm your new email address within 24 hours.
email-change-confirm.heading: Confirm the email change
email-change-confirm.body: A request has been received to use this address as the new login email for a Nailfolio account. If you requested this change, confirm it using the button below within 24 hours.
email-change-confirm.ignoreNote: If it wasn't you, ignore this email. Without confirmation nothing changes.

email-change-notify.preheader: If you did not request an email change, contact support.
email-change-notify.heading: Email change
email-change-notify.body: A request has been received to change your Nailfolio account email to {{newEmail}}. If you requested it, no action is needed. Otherwise, reply to this email or contact support@nailfolio.app.

newsletter-confirm.preheader: Your signup confirmation link is valid for 7 days.
newsletter-confirm.heading: Confirm your newsletter signup
newsletter-confirm.body: Confirm your Nailfolio newsletter signup using the button below within 7 days. Confirmation verifies that this email address belongs to you.
newsletter-confirm.ignoreNote: If you did not sign up, ignore this email. You will not receive the newsletter without confirmation.

winback-deletion-d60.preheader: The account can still be restored with the same email. The code works for 72 hours.
winback-deletion-d60.preheaderNoOffer: You can still restore the account with the same email, for about a month.
winback-deletion-d60.heading: Account restoration deadline
winback-deletion-d60.body:
Your Nailfolio account was closed two months ago. You can still restore it for about a month by signing in with the same email address. After that period, the account will be permanently closed.

A 20% discount is available for your first month of {{planName}}. The code below is assigned to your account and can be used once.
winback-deletion-d60.bodyNoOffer: Your Nailfolio account was closed two months ago. You can still restore it for about a month by signing in with the same email address. After that period, the account will be permanently closed. If you do not want to restore it, no action is needed.
winback-deletion-d60.offerFinePrint: The discount applies to the first monthly plan payment and can be used once. Use the button below to apply it at checkout.
winback-deletion-d60.ps: This is the only reminder about the account restoration deadline.

support-reply-notification.preheader: A reply preview is below. The full conversation is available in the app.
support-reply-notification.heading: New support reply
support-reply-notification.body:
There is a reply in the thread "{{threadSubject}}". The full conversation is available in the app.

{{replyPreview}}

moderation-owner-notification.preheader: Review the decision about your photo and the available actions.
moderation-owner-notification.preheaderBan: Review the reason for the account ban and how to appeal.
moderation-owner-notification.heading: A decision about a photo
moderation-owner-notification.introHide: One of your photos has been hidden after a report was reviewed. The photo has not been deleted, but is not visible to other users.
moderation-owner-notification.introDelete: One of your photos has been removed following a report review because it violated the terms.
moderation-owner-notification.introWarn: A report about one of your photos has been reviewed. The photo remains visible. This is a warning for a violation of the terms. A further violation will result in the photo being hidden or the account being banned.
moderation-owner-notification.introBan: Your account has been banned following a report review. Your photos are hidden and account access is suspended.
moderation-owner-notification.ps: You can appeal the decision by replying to this email or contacting support@nailfolio.app. You will receive a response within 48 hours on business days.
